research.title: Occlusion-Aware Feature Aggregation for Object Detection
bullets: Formulated whether visible-region consistency could improve detection under partial occlusion; led development of a feature aggregation module using spatial confidence weights.
Evaluated controlled occlusion patterns against standard detection baselines, using component ablations and localization error analysis to examine failure cases.

research.title: Illumination-Robust Self-Supervised Depth Estimation
bullets: Investigated how illumination changes distort photometric supervision and led development of a depth training objective combining feature consistency with exposure-aware masking.
Compared alternative masking criteria under synthetic lighting shifts, examining depth discontinuities, textureless surfaces, and sensitivity to photometric augmentation.

research.title: Cross-View Consistency for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Formulated how agreement across transformed views could refine segmentation from image labels; led development of confidence-weighted pseudo-label fusion and consistency training.
Designed ablations separating localization cues, pseudo-label filtering, and boundary regularization; analyzed class confusion and foreground coverage across training stages.

publications.title: Confidence-Weighted Cross-View Pseudo-Label Fusion for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
Foreground Coverage and Boundary Errors in Cross-View Weakly Supervised Segmentation

work.title: Image Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented image validation, resizing, and metadata extraction within an existing processing service, following established interface specifications and error-handling conventions.
Maintained regression tests for malformed uploads and format conversions, investigated processing failures, and documented fixes for operational handoffs.

projects.title: Comparative Image Classification with Limited Training Data
bullets: Implemented convolutional classification baselines and pretrained feature extraction, using consistent data splits and augmentation settings for comparative evaluation.
Compared training from scratch with classifier-only adaptation and full fine-tuning, inspecting learning curves and class-level errors under limited supervision.

projects.title: Stereo Matching Under Texture and Occlusion Challenges
bullets: Implemented block matching and semi-global matching for rectified stereo images, including disparity consistency checks and invalid-pixel handling.
Compared disparity errors across textured, textureless, and occluded regions, examining how matching costs and smoothness penalties affected reconstruction artifacts.

projects.title: Motion and Appearance Cues for Multi-Object Tracking
bullets: Implemented tracking baselines combining motion prediction with assignment-based association, then added appearance features within the same detection-driven pipeline.
Compared association strategies on crowded sequences, analyzing identity switches, fragmented trajectories, and recovery after temporary occlusion using shared detections.

projects.title: Confidence Calibration for Image Classification Under Corruption
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling and histogram binning for image classifiers, fitting calibration parameters on held-out predictions without changing classifier weights.
Compared calibration error and predictive accuracy across blur, noise, and contrast corruptions, examining reliability diagrams and sensitivity to validation distribution.
